title: Italian defense figure in Sorensen story identified as Frank Carlucci
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Italian defense figure in Sorensen story identified as Frank Carlucci, about 1988 at Palmdale, California, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I'm friends with a couple of really good researchers who think that the Italian guy is Frank Carluchi.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, talks about a story told by a man named Sorensen, set in 1988 in Palmdale, California, in which an Italian-seeming defense figure appears around secret aircraft. Michels says a couple of researchers he is friends with believe that man was Frank Carlucci, a senior US defense official later linked to the Carlyle Group, an investment firm. If so, it would tie a high official directly to the story.
